headlines.title: Trump Lands in China Ahead of Historic Meeting with Xi and Putin
headlines.description: President Donald Trump touched down in China Wednesday ahead of a historic three-way meeting with the presidents of China and Russia on Thursday, which Trump says will focus on denuclearization and global security along with the conflicts in Ukraine and Iran. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska’s Senate race, NBC News projects
headlines.description: NBC News projects Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated incumbent Sen. Dan S. Sullivan in Alaska’s Senate race. NBC News’ Steve Patterson reports on the midterm election outcome.

headlines.title: Is the Recent Spate of Tech Outages a Warning Sign?
headlines.description: Josh Tyrangiel who covers AI for The Atlantic and author of “AI for Good,” joins TODAY to share his perspective on all the recent tech outages hitting major companies across the United States. He discusses whether the outages represent a warning sign, what the future looks like, and whether we’re in for a meltdown in the foreseeable future.

headlines.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
headlines.description: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

headlines.title: Jeff Bezos Says He Was ‘Heavily Involved’ in Bond Casting
headlines.description: Amazon founder and chairman Jeff Bezos says he was “heavily involved” in the casting of Robert Pattinson as Amazon MGM Studios’ next James Bond, though he says there was some hesitancy in the selection. “We were slightly biased against him because he’s already so famous,” he says. “We sort of thought maybe we should have somebody a little more unknown.”

headlines.title: Meghan Markle’s father faces new child sex abuse complaints in the Philippines
headlines.description: Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, was charged with the possession of child abuse material, police in the Philippines said.

headlines.title: Highlights from Pope Leo’s historic, 12-day tour of South America
headlines.description: They turned out in their millions to greet Pope Leo as he made his way around Uruguay, Argentina and Peru on a gruelling 12-day tour of the South America.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: They were NFL losers last year. Now they’re playoff contenders.
headlines.description: The Cleveland Browns, Cincinatti Bengals, Kansas City Chiefs, New York Giants, Detroit Lions and Minnesota Vikings all missed the 2025 playoffs, but now make up nearly half of this season’s projected postseason field.

headlines.title: Xi greets Trump as he arrives in China, a rare move ahead of Putin talks
headlines.description: In a rare and surprising move, Chinese leader Xi Jinping personally greeted President Donald Trump as he arrived in China on Wednesday ahead of historic three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

headlines.title: House Democrat warns a dozen Trump allies to save their records, calling it ‘just the beginning’
headlines.description: Democratic Rep. Robert Garcia, who will chair the House Oversight Committee, sent 12 letters to associates of President Donald Trump to save their records ahead of investigations.

headlines.title: Jeff Bezos says he was ‘heavily involved’ in picking the new James Bond
headlines.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos told an audience that he was “heavily involved” with casting Robert Pattinson to play the new James Bond, saying that he displayed “something special.”
